mcq.question: In `if (member) if (has_coupon) a(); else b();`, when does `b()` run?

options.B: When `member` is true and `has_coupon` is false – the `else` belongs to the inner `if`
options.C: Never – the code does not compile

mcq.explanation: An else binds to the nearest unmatched if, regardless of indentation. This is the dangling-else trap that braces on every branch prevent.

mcq.question: When is an object declared inside a `for` loop body destroyed?

options.B: At the end of the enclosing function
options.D: At the end of every iteration, when the body's closing brace is reached

mcq.explanation: The loop body is a block. Each iteration enters it again, constructing the object, and leaves it at the closing brace, destroying it. The block-scope demo shows this order.
